**Yes. One component-issue event for manufacturing order MO-25-09-1070 was created 75 minutes after September entered Pending Close. Its recorded `POSTED` status is inconsistent with Oracle’s documented treatment.**

### Audit finding

| Item | Recorded value |
|---|---|
| Manufacturing order | **MO-25-09-1070** |
| Work order ID | `WO-2025-09-004` |
| Operation / product | Racine DeKoven — Cooler Plate Pack |
| Cost event | `CE-250904-0004` — `INPUT` (component issue) |
| Source transaction | **`TXN-ISSUE-250930-1070`** |
| Amount | **USD $284,763.42** (`28,476,342` cents) |
| Cost period | `Sep-25` — `PER-COST-2025-09` |
| Exact Pending Close time | **`2025-09-30T18:00:00`** |
| Exact event-created time | **`2025-09-30T19:15:00`** |
| Time after Pending Close | **75 minutes** — 1 hour 15 minutes |
| Recorded accounting status | **`POSTED`** |

**Calculation:** `19:15:00 − 18:00:00 = 4,500 seconds ÷ 60 = 75 minutes`.

The timestamps above are reproduced exactly as recorded; the source does not specify a time-zone offset.

### Policy conclusion

The supplied Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM Cost Management 26B documentation states that newly created transactions falling in the Pending Close period or an earlier period **will not be staged in Cost Accounting or Receipt Accounting** until the period is closed or reopened. Pre-existing transactions can continue processing, as can the specified exceptions: revenue lines, COGS recognition, and manual cost adjustments.

This event was a **new component issue dated September 30**, created after the cutoff—not an identified exception. Its `POSTED` status therefore **does not conform to the documented Pending Close treatment**; it should have been held from staging and processing.

**Sources:** `state.db` tables `work_orders`, `cost_periods`, and `work_order_cost_events`; supplied Oracle 26B guide, “Cost Accounting Period Statuses and Transaction Accounting,” PDF page 233 / printed page 225.

The review was read-only; no database records were changed. The report was submitted and verified, and the audit result with provenance was saved to `/cache/work/worker_85c0bb4450b2/audit-report.json`.

## Finding: an event was created 145 minutes after Pending Close

The relevant Racine manufacturing order is **MO-25-09-1070**, work order **WO-2025-09-004**, for the **Cooler Plate Pack**. One associated cost event was created after the September cost period entered Pending Close.

| Audit item | Recorded value |
|---|---|
| Source transaction | **TXN-ISSUE-250930-1070** |
| Cost event | CE-250904-0004 |
| Event type | INPUT — component issue |
| Amount | **USD $318,250.75** (31,825,075 cents) |
| Cost period | Sep-25 / PER-COST-2025-09 |
| Event-created time | **2025-09-30T20:25:00** |
| Pending Close time | **2025-09-30T18:00:00** |
| Time after Pending Close | **145 minutes — 2 hours, 25 minutes** |
| Recorded accounting status | **POSTED** |

**Calculation:** `20:25:00 − 18:00:00 = 8,700 seconds ÷ 60 = 145 minutes.`  
The timestamps are reproduced exactly as recorded; no time-zone offset was supplied.

### Policy conclusion

**The recorded POSTED status is inconsistent with Oracle’s documented Pending Close treatment**, based on the supplied period state and records.

Oracle’s *Cost Accounting Period Statuses and Transaction Accounting* section states that newly created transactions falling in or before a Pending Close period are not staged in Cost Accounting or Receipt Accounting and will be processed after the period is closed or reopened. Transactions entered before Pending Close can continue processing. The stated exceptions—revenue lines, COGS recognition, and manual cost adjustments—do **not** cover this ordinary component-issue INPUT event.

**Sources:** Supplied `work_orders`, `cost_periods`, and `work_order_cost_events` records from `system/oracle_scm_cost_management/state.db`; Oracle SCM Cost Management 26B policy excerpt, PDF page **233**, printed page **225**.

No database records were changed. The audit report was submitted and verified, and the result with provenance was saved to `/cache/work/worker_b6b4b8cc5fe5/audit-report.json`.
